title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2025.3.170763, 2026.1.14150, 2026.2.19656 improper URL validation in the app widget host…
description: JetBrains YouTrack versions before 2025.3.170763, 2026.1.14150, and 2026.2.19656 contain an improper URL validation vulnerability in the app widget host. This flaw allows applications to send REST requests without requiring user confirmation, potentially leading to unauthorized actions. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.4 CVSS v3.1.
